answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the comet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A quill of per-task receipts records who did what, and the harbor of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
